post.description: Open a session: the access token, and the refresh token in its cookie.
Revoke the session's refresh token and delete its cookie.

get.description: The signed-in board member, as shown in the board space.

post.description:
Record the password chosen from a link, which then holds no more. No
session opens: the member signs in, their address filled in.
The account a link leads to, while the link holds: the page names it.
post.summary: Check a link to choose a password

post.description: Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token and a new cookie.

get.description: Every account, with its state, by name.

post.description:
Make the account of a board member, who chooses their password from the
link the email gives. The answer tells whether the email went out.
« Envoyer un nouveau lien »: an invitation again, or a password forgotten.

delete.summary: Take a volunteer off a station

get.description:
The documents, by page, the latest date first: a search keeps those holding
its words, in their texts, amount or event.

post.description:
Record a file, as the member classifies it: it awaits review.

The type is read from the content: a PDF, or an image, converted to WebP.

get.description:
How many documents answer a search, in all and by category, whatever the
category shown: the counts of the list's chips, whole.

delete.description: Delete a document and its file.

put.description: Rewrite a document whole: how it is classified, and its fields.

get.description: The file, of the type recorded for it: shown in the browser, or downloaded.
get.summary: Read the file of a document

post.description: Validate a document awaiting review: minutes create the tasks they list.

get.description:
What each equipment offers today, by category: its pieces, those taken
today and those under repair, with the figures of the inventory.

For each equipment: what the loans take of it at their daily peak over
the period, what remains free, and those loans. The loan being edited is
left out: its own pieces do not stand in its way.
get.summary: Tell what equipment is free over a period

delete.description: Delete an equipment no loan names.

put.description:
Rewrite an equipment whole, such as the pieces put back in service.

Fewer pieces offered are refused if a loan to come would then lack some.

get.description:
The loans that take an equipment, from the Monday of this week, for
eleven weeks.

The events of the board, by page.

Upcoming events come the next first; past ones, like the whole list, the
latest first. An event stays upcoming until the end of its last day.

post.description: Record an event, with its programme and practical info.

delete.description: Delete an event, with its programme and practical info.

get.description: An event with all its content.

put.description: Rewrite an event whole: its programme and practical info are replaced.
Set how many places the reservations may take, or no limit: the figures follow.
put.summary: Set the capacity of an event

get.description: The counts of an event's tabs, whole: a bounded aggregate, never paginated.
The reservations of an event, by page, the latest first.
get.summary: List the reservations of an event

post.description: Record a reservation, within the event's capacity.

get.description: The reservations as an Excel workbook, in the v1's format.
get.summary: Export the reservations of an event

get.description: The reservations, places taken and still free, and the places by type, whole.
get.summary: Figures of the reservations of an event

get.description: The stations of an event and their totals, whole: a bounded aggregate.

post.description: Add a station after the event's others.
post.summary: Add a station to an event

put.description: Give the event's stations a new order: each of them, once.
put.summary: Reorder the stations of an event

post.summary: Add a type of place to an event

get.description:
The loans, by page: late, out, to prepare, confirmed, the committee's to
come, then those over, the latest first. A state keeps its own.

post.description:
Record a loan, never beyond what is free over its days (A15): a loan to
someone takes the next number of its year.

get.description: How many loans in all, and in each state: the counts of the list's chips.
The cheque each type of borrower leaves by default (A16).

The loans over nine weeks, from the Monday of the week before: those of
the committee and those returned too, the cancelled left out.
get.summary: Read the planning of the loans

put.description:
Rewrite a loan whole, its lines replaced, never beyond what is free over
its days, its own pieces left out.

post.description:
« Déposer la convention signée »: a document « Divers », awaiting review,
which takes the link of the loan. A committee loan has none.
post.summary: Deposit the signed agreement of a loan

post.description:
« Préparer la sortie »: the loan holds its equipment from today, even
before its start, and is refused if it is not free by then.
post.summary: Hand the equipment of a loan over

post.description: « Rouvrir »: the return is undone, if the equipment is still free.

« Valider le retour »: what is damaged goes under repair, what is missing
is reported. The loans to come that the repairs leave short are named.
post.summary: Record the return of a loan

get.description: The active board members, by name: the accounts that may lead an event.

The notes of an event, by page: the pinned ones first, then the latest,
each with its replies.
get.summary: List the notes of an event

post.description: Record a note of the signed-in member, on an event or general.

delete.description: Delete a note with its replies, or a reply. Only its author finds it.

put.description: Rewrite a note or a reply. Only its author finds it: anyone else gets a 404.

post.description: Record a reply of the signed-in member. A reply cannot be answered: 404.

get.description: The dashboard's figures, whole: a bounded aggregate, never paginated.

put.description: Rewrite a reservation, its places replaced: only an increase meets the capacity.

delete.description: Delete a station, with the people at it.

post.summary: Put a volunteer at a station

get.description: The tasks of an event, by page: open first by due date, then those done.
get.summary: List the tasks of an event

post.description: Record a task of the signed-in member.

get.description: The tasks without an event (D10), by page, in the same order as an event's.

put.description: Rewrite a task whole: ticking it done records when.

delete.description: Delete a type of place no reservation uses: one in use is refused (422).

get.description: Report whether the service can answer, and which release is running.
The categories of the agenda's events, and when the board last changed one.
Every published event, past ones included: a subscribed calendar keeps them.
The published events to come, the next first, by page.
A published event's page, past ones included, with the events that follow it.
A published event, to add to one's calendar.
